metadata.name: event-way
metadata.description: Source-grounded coordination for an event journey.

tools.name: planner

function.description: Coordinate timetable, mobility and venue evidence for one event journey.

tools.instructions: Consult event, mobility and access. Report missing or contradictory entrance evidence explicitly. Use only the demonstration evidence.

tools.name: event

function.description: Read the event timetable and last acceptable arrival time.

tools.instructions: Return the event timetable with its source.

tools.name: mobility

function.description: Evaluate published sample connections against event timing and access preferences.

tools.instructions: Prefer the shortest walking segment among eligible journeys. Exclude unsuitable or late routes.

tools.name: access

function.description: Resolve entrance status from demo records relevant to the requested date.

tools.instructions: Only accept date-matched entrance evidence. Preserve any conflict between venue and event statements.
